basis: Retinal vasculitis, arterial aneurysms and neuroretinitis define this inflammatory ocular vascular syndrome; no common extraocular damage established.

Lysosomal storage causes progressive neurodegeneration; retinal degeneration and progressive visual loss are characteristic, with visual loss in 2/2 annotated patients.
Phenylalanine metabolism defect; untreated neurodevelopmental damage and eczematoid dermatitis each frequent (30-79%); osteopenia may reflect dietary treatment.
Disordered reflex blood-pressure regulation defines it; neural mediation does not establish structural or lasting neurologic damage.
Inherited platelet dysfunction and immunodeficiency; chronic eczema is characteristic and colitis reported in 1/3. Additional vascular involvement omitted under the four-axis cap.
Inherited resistance to coumarin anticoagulants concerns regulation of coagulation; no intrinsic hepatic damage or common extra-organ injury established.
Inflammation of the iris and ciliary body is ocular inflammatory disease; no common extraocular damage follows from this umbrella diagnosis.
Usher type 2 combines congenital sensorineural hearing impairment with progressive rod-cone retinal dystrophy.
Unequal breast development affects an organ outside the specified axes.
Multiloculated cystic renal neoplasm arises in the kidney; no common extra-organ involvement established.
Orofaciodigital classification establishes oral and digital skeletal malformations; supplied evidence does not establish common additional organ damage.
Glycosylation defect; severe developmental delay in 9/9 and frequent seizures support neurologic involvement. Ocular, renal and cardiac anomalies have only single-case annotations.
Carcinoma originates in the stomach; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish an endocrine disorder.
Prenatal alcohol exposure causes defining central nervous system dysfunction; facial appearance and growth deficiency do not establish other organ damage.

Etiologic umbrella without a shared organ axis; inherited diseases span all systems, and inheritance alone does not imply a metabolic disorder.
Acquired disease of skeletal muscle; inflammatory or immune mechanisms apply to some subtypes rather than the entire umbrella.
Sinonasal and cutaneous infection each frequent (30-79%); destructive arterial invasion is characteristic. Ocular, CNS and gastrointestinal damage are minority manifestations.
Inherited marrow failure; skeletal malformations affect roughly 30-50%. Renal anomalies are near or below 30%; pigmentation alone does not establish skin damage.
Folate deficiency causes impaired blood-cell production and megaloblastic anemia; no common direct extra-organ damage established.
Familial cortical myoclonus and epilepsy define a neurologic disorder; myoclonus does not indicate primary skeletal muscle damage.
Glycogen branching enzyme deficiency with nonprogressive hepatic glycogen accumulation; neuromuscular involvement of other subtypes is not assumed.
Neonatal metabolic acidosis, neurologic dysfunction and severe hypertrophic cardiomyopathy define this form; hepatic and coagulation abnormalities occur in only 5-29%.
Inherited disruption of peptide or amine metabolism defines the umbrella; no additional organ damage is shared across most subtypes.
